portfolio.name: Daniel Zhuo
about: Ever since baby me saw a camera, it was over. He's a film kid now.

My video editing journey began in Grade 7, and I've made plenty of questionable creative decisions ever since. A lot of what I make is inspired by the early YouTube I grew up with. A little chaotic, a little unserious, but always made with care. These days, I bounce between client work, random side quests, and short films with friends. Hopefully you'll find something here you like. 😄
